obcas.slovak: Občas chodíme po práci na kávu.
obcas.english: We sometimes go for coffee after work.

obcas.slovak: Občas si pustím slovenské rádio cestou do práce.
obcas.english: I sometimes listen to Slovak radio on my way to work.
The computer sometimes restarts by itself.

obcas.slovak: Občas je dobré nechať telefón doma.
obcas.english: Sometimes it is good to leave your phone at home.

privelmi.english: I have too much of work.

zaroven.slovak: Deti sa učia plávať a zároveň sa zabávajú.
zaroven.english: The children are learning to swim and having fun at the same time.

zaroven.slovak: Môžeš počúvať podcast a zároveň variť večeru.
zaroven.english: You can listen to a podcast and cook dinner at the same time.

zaroven.slovak: Pracujem z domu a zároveň sa starám o psa.
zaroven.english: I work from home while also looking after the dog.

zaroven.slovak: Obaja prišli zároveň, hoci bývajú na opačných koncoch mesta.
zaroven.english: They both arrived at the same time, although they live on opposite sides of town.

pritom.slovak: Peter varil večeru a pritom telefonoval s mamou.
pritom.english: Peter was cooking dinner while talking to his mother on the phone.

pritom.slovak: Cestou domov počúvala hudbu a pritom sledovala dážď za oknom.
pritom.english: On the way home, she listened to music while watching the rain outside the window.

pritom.slovak: Tvrdí, že nemá čas, pritom každý večer pozerá seriály.
pritom.english: He says he has no time, yet he watches series every evening.

pritom.slovak: Vysvetľoval mi cestu a pritom kreslil mapu na papier.
pritom.english: He explained the route to me while drawing a map on paper.

postupne.slovak: Postupne sme si zvykli na nový rozvrh.
postupne.english: We gradually got used to the new schedule.

postupne.slovak: Slnko postupne roztopilo sneh na chodníku.
postupne.english: The sun gradually melted the snow on the pavement.

postupne.slovak: Učiteľ vysvetľoval pravidlá postupne, krok za krokom.
postupne.english: The teacher explained the rules gradually, step by step.

postupne.slovak: Po chorobe začala postupne opäť cvičiť.
postupne.english: After being ill, she gradually started exercising again.

nadalej.slovak: Aj po presťahovaní budeme naďalej v kontakte.
nadalej.english: We will stay in touch even after moving.

nadalej.slovak: Obchod bude naďalej otvorený aj v sobotu.
nadalej.english: The shop will continue to be open on Saturdays as well.

nadalej.slovak: Prosím, naďalej používajte nový vstup do budovy.
nadalej.english: Please continue to use the new entrance to the building.

nadalej.slovak: Napriek dažďu vlaky naďalej jazdia podľa cestovného poriadku.
nadalej.english: Despite the rain, the trains are still running according to the timetable.

vyrazne.slovak: Po oprave auto výrazne menej spotrebúva palivo.
vyrazne.english: After the repair, the car uses significantly less fuel.

vyrazne.slovak: Nové okuliare jej výrazne zlepšili videnie.
vyrazne.english: The new glasses significantly improved her vision.

vyrazne.slovak: V zime sa výrazne skôr stmieva.
vyrazne.english: In winter, it gets dark noticeably earlier.

vyrazne.slovak: Ceny ovocia sa tento týždeň výrazne nezmenili.
vyrazne.english: Fruit prices have not changed significantly this week.

coraz.slovak: Dni sú na jeseň čoraz kratšie.
coraz.english: The days get shorter and shorter in autumn.

coraz.slovak: Čoraz viac ľudí pracuje z domu.
coraz.english: More and more people work from home.

coraz.slovak: Počas behu sa mu dýchalo čoraz ťažšie.
coraz.english: As he ran, it became harder and harder for him to breathe.

coraz.slovak: Po každej lekcii čoraz lepšie rozumiem po slovensky.
coraz.english: With every lesson, I understand Slovak better and better.

tesne.english: We live right by the station.
The bus arrived just before eight.
